statements: CREATE TABLE data.meetings (id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, title text, held_on date, timezone text)
CREATE TABLE data.people (id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, external_identity text UNIQUE, name text)

CREATE TABLE data.participants (id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, meeting_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES data.meetings(id), person_id bigint REFERENCES data.people(id), label text NOT NULL, UNIQUE (meeting_id, id))

CREATE TABLE data.turns (id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, meeting_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES data.meetings(id), participant_id bigint NOT NULL, ordinal integer NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal > 0), body text NOT NULL, starts_at numeric(12,3), ends_at numeric(12,3), UNIQUE (meeting_id, ordinal), FOREIGN KEY (meeting_id, participant_id) REFERENCES data.participants(meeting_id, id))

annotations.description: Speaker labels within a meeting; labels are not verified identities.

metadata.conventions: Reuse a person only after matching a verified external identity. Keep person_id NULL otherwise.

annotations.description: Ordered verbatim utterances linked to the meeting and its participants.

metadata.conventions: ordinal is global within a meeting. Missing dates, timestamps and identities remain NULL.
